身体の一貫性：
身長約166cm。脚が長く、自信のある姿勢。健康的で軽く引き締まった成人の砂時計型体型。胸は自然に豊かで、胸郭に釣り合う現実的な付け根の幅、前方への厚み、柔らかな重さと重力を持つ。腰はくびれているが現実的で、ヒップと臀部は適度にふっくらして少し大きめの丸みがあり、骨盤から太ももへ自然につながる。視点が変わっても身長、胸郭、腰、骨盤、ヒップの量感、手足の比率を保つ。普通の不透明な衣服と自然な布の張りを使う。持ち上げる胸の補正、胸の谷間、パッド、極端な締め付け、インプラントのような球形、不可能な細い腰、誇張したヒップ、BBL風の輪郭にはしない。

13:30。陶器店で自分用のマグを一個選ぶ。色と手触りを真剣に確かめる。

路地の小さな器屋。木棚の器。少し不整形なチャコールの陶器マグ、内側白、丸い持ち手。

promptTranslations.en:
Character Identity:
A fictional 30-year-old adult Japanese woman. A cheerful bakery café manager with a sophisticated, playful influencer-like presence. A petite, softly rounded oval face, gently plump cheeks, and a rounded chin. Large, expressive dark brown double-lidded eyes, intermediate between almond-shaped and round, with very slightly drooping outer corners. Neatly groomed, gentle arched eyebrows, a naturally straight nose with a slightly rounded tip, and soft, plump lips with naturally upturned corners. Fair, warm-neutral Japanese skin retaining realistic pores, light natural redness, subtle freckles across the bridge of the nose, and slight facial asymmetry. Exactly one tiny mole beneath the outer corner of her anatomical left eye. Her signature smile is a bright, playful, tooth-revealing grin that forms dimples on both cheeks. Hair is a shoulder-length, smooth straight layered bob. The part is slightly off-center, with only the ends curving inward naturally. The outer surface, roots, crown, part, bangs, and upper hair framing the face are a uniform, glossy black to dark charcoal. A cool smoky gray to graphite silver inner color exists only beneath that dark surface layer, visible solely where tucked behind the ears and at the lower inner ends. Do not make it center-split, half-and-half color-blocked, a center band, gray roots or crown, face-framing highlights, a gradient, or an entirely gray head. Modern influencer makeup features defined eyelashes, understated taupe eyeliner, and rose-beige lips, without smoothing the skin like plastic. Thin, round black metal or gunmetal eyeglasses are an optional signature accessory. Maintain the fictional adult facial features, face shape, freckles, correct placement of the mole, dimples, black outer hair layer, inner color placement, hair length, and adult age aesthetic described here, avoiding resemblance to any identifiable real person.

Body Consistency:
Height approximately 166 cm. Long legs with a confident posture. A healthy, lightly toned adult hourglass figure. Breasts are naturally full, with realistic base width proportional to the ribcage, forward volume, soft weight, and natural gravity. The waist is tapered yet realistic; hips and buttocks are moderately full with a slightly prominent curvature, transitioning naturally from the pelvis to the thighs. Maintain consistent height, ribcage, waist, pelvis, hip volume, and limb proportions regardless of the viewing angle. Wear normal, opaque clothing with natural fabric tension. Do not use push-up cleavage enhancements, extreme cinching, implant-like spheres, impossibly thin waists, exaggerated hips, or BBL-style contours.

Shooting Situation:
13:30. In a ceramics shop, picking out a mug for herself. Earnestly checking its color and texture.

Location and Background:
A small pottery shop on an alleyway. Ceramics displayed on wooden shelves. A slightly asymmetrical charcoal ceramic mug, white interior, round handle.

Outfit:
A thin, opaque, form-fitting charcoal sleeveless top, a black ankle-length lightweight maxi skirt, and black flat sandals. Thin, black-rimmed round glasses, thin silver hoops, and a small black shoulder bag.

Pose and Action:
Standing, supporting the bottom of the mug with her left hand, and resting the fingers of her right hand along the handle. Eyes focused on the mug. Expression and Face Direction: Face turned 70 degrees to the right of the frame, nearly in profile. No lateral tilt of the neck; chin slightly pulled in, casting her gaze down toward the mug. Eyebrows and mouth relaxed, lips closed in an earnest expression of appraisal. Not smiling.

Composition and Angle:
A standard smartphone 1x lens shot by a friend, distance 1.4 m, height 1.2 m. Framing from head to knees, capturing both hands and the mug.
Output a single undivided image with a final resolution of 1086×1448 px and a 3:4 aspect ratio.

Lighting and Atmosphere:
Natural light from the storefront mixed with warm, dim interior store lighting.

Photographic Texture:
A single, minimally processed HEIC photograph captured with a standard smartphone camera app. Do not conflate the character's body and hair shape with surface rendering. Follow the camera's single AF plane without selectively relighting, denoising, or sharpening distant facial features. Fine details fall off smoothly with distance. To the extent the face remains recognizable, preserve multiple broad tonal variances simultaneously—such as warm tones on one cheek, uneven sheen across the T-zone, color differences beneath each eye, and slight redness on the nose—without drawing distinct pores on a distant face. Skin that is close enough to resolve should show non-repeating, low-contrast tonal shifts, pressure marks, subtle crease shadows, and sparse pore variations. Makeup must appear as actual pigment with slightly uneven edges; lips and teeth must maintain normal, uncorrected color differences. Retain uneven exposure and white balance, unlifted shadows, subtle flyaway hairs, off-center framing, shadow noise, conservative sharpening near the AF focal plane, and typical HEIC compression. Present it as an unedited snapshot straight from a personal camera roll.

Mandatory Requirements:
Output a single, undivided smartphone photograph of an adult woman matching all scene specifications. Fulfill both the scene acceptance criteria and natural smartphone photography quality standards.

One fictional 30-year-old adult woman. Friend and photographer are off-camera.
Acceptance Criteria:
1) Maintain the woman's adult face, round glasses, black shoulder-length bob, and lower-layer gray.
2) Outfit, scene, main action, and accessories match, with natural fingers and object interaction.
3) Specified framing and full frame layout correctly realized.
4) An everyday smartphone photo with distance-dependent resolution rolloff, natural skin tonal differences, and realistic material textures.
5) Face turned 70 degrees to the right of the frame, nearly in profile. No lateral tilt of the neck, chin slightly pulled in, looking down at the mug. Eyebrows and mouth relaxed, lips closed in an earnest expression of appraisal. Not smiling.

Retain specified accessories.

Black shoulder-length straight bob with gray inner color only around the ears and lower layer. Upper layer of hair is black. Maintain round glasses. Opaque fabric.

Her body has exactly two arms and two hands. Ensure natural contact between hands and objects, and natural body support. Strictly follow the expression and gaze for this scene. Her signature smile and dimples are traits for when she smiles, not a constant toothy grin.

Single AF point on the face. Single standalone vertical 3:4 photograph. Leave margin without cropping the specified head, hands, or limbs at the edges.
Only one image. Maintain specified aspect ratio and full-figure framing requirements.

Natural shadows and exposure differences.

Only a single AF tier. No selective face exposure correction, relighting, skin-smoothing, or restoration. Retain broad tonal variations on distant faces and irregular textures on close skin, keeping smartphone-typical processing artifacts localized.

Depict only one clearly adult fictional woman as the sole subject of an undivided single photograph. One head, one face, exactly two anatomically connected arms, and naturally shaped hands. Another person's hands in the foreground are only permissible if explicitly specified in the scene or props, and must be clearly separated from her body. No text, panels, duplicate individuals, or alternate angles.
